blocker_for_valid_metric: A predeclared common endpoint and immutable mapping between scorer fields and native criteria are absent; creating either would be new validation design, not analysis of the frozen outputs.
evidence_sources: eval/system_validation_scoring.py: structured Memora correctness requires all extracted content_data leaf facts
Memora evals/README.md: native per-question FAMA combines memory-presence and forgetting-absence accuracies
independent_semantic_unit: one native evaluation sub-question/atomic criterion; native benchmark aggregates these as accuracy components and per-question FAMA

path_1_answer_level_aggregation.reason: The native benchmark defines per-question FAMA from memory-presence and forgetting-absence accuracies, not a frozen Boolean all-criteria-pass label. GovMem's Boolean scorer covers extracted content_data facts and does not encode the native forgetting penalty, so an all-pass or any-pass projection would invent a new target.

path_2_criterion_level_recovery.reason: Frozen scorer details expose content_data field paths and support bits, but B4 criteria expose native evaluation-question IDs/types and hashes without an immutable field-to-criterion mapping. The criteria also include forgetting_absence items absent from scorer field details.

recommended_valid_comparison_unit: none available from the current frozen artifacts
scorer_semantic_unit: one generated answer; Boolean correct only when every extracted content_data leaf fact is deterministically supported
